conditions: Complete native mutation inventory AND separate complete forward write-statement inventory
Intact supported rollback input, no external journal corruption or page moves
At most one implicit statement savepoint; no explicit/overlapping savepoints, callbacks, retries or continued writing after rollback/SQLite error
derivation: Complete counted native mutations bound every live logical page count. Separate fixed SQL statement counts bound statement starts only, not B-tree operations. Strict PRE206 has9 explicit DDL statements+1 receipt INSERT; strict PRE214 has23+1. Implicit indexes are not extra SQL statements.

Pinned fresh handle has one top-level immediate transaction, sequential synchronous SQL and no explicit/nested/overlapping savepoints or UDF/extension callbacks. Statement rollback or SQL errors leave the owner; no continued writing/retry is supported. Receipt triggers/index hazards and non-PRE profiles refuse via the separate complete native inventory.

OP_Transaction opens an implicit statement transaction only when usesStmtJournal && writing && nonautocommit/other reader conditions. usesStmtJournal is derived from isMultiWrite&&mayAbort. Transaction P5 is schema-cookie checking, NOT a journal-enabled flag; missing EXPLAIN comments never imply zero journal.

Each implicit savepoint records nOrig=Pager.dbSize and a per-page bitvec. subjRequiresPage requires pgno<=nOrig and an unset bit; successful record writing sets that bit. Without rollback/continued writes, each such page is recorded at most once for the statement.

Subjournal content uses nSubRec*(P+4): four-byte page number followed by exactly P bytes, with no rollback-journal headers/sector padding. Nmax*(P+4) per possible forward SQL statement is a conservative content-write charge.

All possible statement content writes are summed without taking truncation, offset reuse, file close/delete, previous-page, rollback or memory buffering credit. A retained/reused single physical file is bounded by the full cumulative sum, not one-statement content. At most one journal file creation per statement is charged; aggregate rounded charges cover any grouping of consecutive statements.

Default nStmtSpill is64KiB in the pinned source, but no memory-only claim or threshold credit is used. sqlite3JournalCreate can force a file independently of the automatic positive-threshold spill. MemJournal prefix copying and subsequent appends stay within written logical offsets.

This is LOGICAL CONTENT only. VFS/chunk/mmap/preallocation/default compiled-runtime binding/physical blocks remain separate and unproved. Source-bound collector wrapper still does not independently prove private DB content. No writer admission or held capacity integration exists for this new primitive.
All SQL sorters/materialized-query temp files, WAL/SHM, full transient originals and continuous peaks remain outside the subjournal content formula; the broader scratch flag remains false.

A first main-journal write can satisfy a savepoint without a subjournal. Native fixtures use two forward writes and a deliberate later CHECK abort; read-only verification proves prior-statement data survives the statement abort before the owner exits and fully rolls back. Windows directory sampling may remain empty: no positive disk-spill/size/peak or zero-spill inference is made. This validates logical statement rollback semantics only; VFS/physical/full-lifetime obligations remain unclosed.

-- #206: additive physical container identities; no historical aliquot backfill.
CREATE TABLE "SampleContainer" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    "sampleId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "parentId" TEXT,
    "kind" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "code" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "massG" REAL,
    "createdAt" DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    "createdBy" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "storageLocationId" TEXT,
    "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
    CONSTRAINT "SampleContainer_sampleId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("sampleId") REFERENCES "Sample" ("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT "SampleContainer_parentId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("parentId") REFERENCES "SampleContainer" ("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "SampleContainer_code_key" ON "SampleContainer"("code");
CREATE INDEX "SampleContainer_sampleId_idx" ON "SampleContainer"("sampleId");
CREATE INDEX "SampleContainer_parentId_idx" ON "SampleContainer"("parentId");

-- Separate additive counter avoids gaps in the historical SAMPLE namespace.
-- This guarded allocator table is managed by the receipt installer, not db push.
CREATE TABLE "ContainerSequence" (
    "labId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "year" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("year" >= 0),
    "next" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("next" >= 1),
    PRIMARY KEY ("labId", "year")
);

-- Contract guards
CREATE TRIGGER "SampleContainer_validate_insert" BEFORE INSERT ON "SampleContainer"
WHEN NEW."kind" NOT IN ('BULK','FINE_EARTH','GROUND','ALIQUOT','ARCHIVE')
 OR NEW."status" <> 'ACTIVE' OR NEW."storageLocationId" IS NOT NULL
 OR length(trim(NEW."id")) = 0 OR length(trim(NEW."code")) = 0
 OR length(trim(NEW."createdBy")) = 0 OR upper(trim(NEW."createdBy")) IN ('SYSTEM','UNKNOWN')
 OR (NEW."massG" IS NOT NULL AND (typeof(NEW."massG") NOT IN ('integer','real') OR NEW."massG" <= 0 OR NEW."massG" > 1.7976931348623157e308))
 OR (NEW."parentId" IS NULL AND NEW."kind" <> 'BULK')
 OR (NEW."parentId" IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "SampleContainer" parent
     WHERE parent."id" = NEW."parentId" AND parent."sampleId" = NEW."sampleId" AND parent."status" = 'ACTIVE'))
 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Sample" sample WHERE NEW."code" IN (sample."id",sample."originalId",sample."labId",sample."labSampleCode"))
BEGIN
 SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'SAMPLE_CONTAINER_INVALID');
END;

-- The existing nullable attempt column is retained byte-for-byte. Only new
-- attempts can acquire a same-sample physical aliquot; #191 still freezes it.
CREATE TRIGGER "WorkAttempt_aliquot_insert" BEFORE INSERT ON "WorkAttempt"
WHEN NEW."aliquotId" IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "SampleContainer" container
 JOIN "WorkItem" work ON work."sampleId" = container."sampleId"
 WHERE work."id" = NEW."workItemId" AND container."id" = NEW."aliquotId"
 AND container."kind" = 'ALIQUOT' AND container."status" = 'ACTIVE')
BEGIN
 SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'SAMPLE_CONTAINER_ALIQUOT_INVALID');
END;

    CONSTRAINT "ControlLimitProposal_labId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("labId") REFERENCES "Lab" ("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,

    CONSTRAINT "ControlLimitProposal_referenceMaterialId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("referenceMaterialId") REFERENCES "ReferenceMaterial" ("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE "ControlLimitSet" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    "labId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "analysisCode" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "methodologyId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "referenceMaterialId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "proposalId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "mean" REAL NOT NULL,
    "sd" REAL NOT NULL,
    "n" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "fromDate" DATETIME NOT NULL,
    "toDate" DATETIME,
    "approvedBy" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "status" TEXT NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "ControlLimitSet_labId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("labId") REFERENCES "Lab" ("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT "ControlLimitSet_methodologyId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("methodologyId") REFERENCES "Methodology" ("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT "ControlLimitSet_referenceMaterialId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("referenceMaterialId") REFERENCES "ReferenceMaterial" ("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT "ControlLimitSet_proposalId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("proposalId") REFERENCES "ControlLimitProposal" ("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

);

);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ControlLimitSet_proposalId_key" ON "ControlLimitSet"("proposalId");

-- Contract guards: no historical QC/policy row or evaluation is rewritten.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ControlLimitSet_one_approved_series" ON "ControlLimitSet"("labId", "analysisCode", "methodologyId", "referenceMaterialId") WHERE "status"='APPROVED';

CREATE TRIGGER "control_limit_proposal_insert" BEFORE INSERT ON "ControlLimitProposal"
BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN NEW."n"<2 OR NEW."sd"<=0 OR length(trim(NEW."reason"))=0 OR NOT json_valid(NEW."selectionSnapshot") OR NOT json_valid(NEW."policySnapshot")
  OR json_type(NEW."selectionSnapshot")<>'array'
  OR NEW."n" < coalesce(json_extract(NEW."policySnapshot", '$.values."qc.controlChartMinPoints"'),2147483647)
  OR NEW."n" <> (SELECT count(*) FROM json_each(NEW."selectionSnapshot") WHERE json_extract(value,'$.selected')=1)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(NEW."selectionSnapshot") WHERE json_extract(value,'$.selected')=0 AND length(trim(coalesce(json_extract(value,'$.exclusionReason'),'')))=0)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "Methodology" m WHERE m."id"=NEW."methodologyId" AND m."analysisCode"=NEW."analysisCode" AND (m."labId" IS NULL OR m."labId" IN (NEW."labId",(SELECT "code" FROM "Lab" WHERE "id"=NEW."labId"))))
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "ReferenceMaterial" r WHERE r."id"=NEW."referenceMaterialId" AND r."labId"=NEW."labId")
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "User" WHERE "username"=NEW."proposedBy")
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'QC_CHART_PROPOSAL_INVALID') END;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER "control_limit_set_insert" BEFORE INSERT ON "ControlLimitSet"
BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN NEW."status"<>'APPROVED' OR NEW."toDate" IS NOT NULL OR NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM "ControlLimitProposal" p WHERE p."id"=NEW."proposalId" AND p."labId"=NEW."labId" AND p."analysisCode"=NEW."analysisCode"
   AND p."methodologyId"=NEW."methodologyId" AND p."referenceMaterialId"=NEW."referenceMaterialId"
   AND p."mean"=NEW."mean" AND p."sd"=NEW."sd" AND p."n"=NEW."n" AND p."proposedBy"<>NEW."approvedBy")
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "User" WHERE "username"=NEW."approvedBy")
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'QC_CHART_APPROVAL_INVALID') END;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER "qc_review_obligation_insert" BEFORE INSERT ON "QcReviewObligation"
BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN NOT json_valid(NEW."evidenceSnapshot") OR json_type(NEW."evidenceSnapshot")<>'array'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "QcEvaluation" e JOIN "Batch" b ON b."id"=e."batchId", json_each(e."details",'$.evaluation.controlCharts') c, json_each(c.value,'$.review') r
   WHERE e."id"=NEW."evaluationId" AND b."labId"=NEW."labId" AND r.value=NEW."rule")
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'QC_CHART_REVIEW_INVALID') END;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER "control_limit_set_supersede_only" BEFORE UPDATE ON "ControlLimitSet"
BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN OLD."status"<>'APPROVED' OR NEW."status"<>'SUPERSEDED' OR OLD."toDate" IS NOT NULL OR NEW."toDate" IS NULL
  OR NEW."toDate"<OLD."fromDate" OR NEW."id" IS NOT OLD."id" OR NEW."labId" IS NOT OLD."labId"
  OR NEW."analysisCode" IS NOT OLD."analysisCode" OR NEW."methodologyId" IS NOT OLD."methodologyId"
  OR NEW."referenceMaterialId" IS NOT OLD."referenceMaterialId" OR NEW."proposalId" IS NOT OLD."proposalId"
  OR NEW."mean" IS NOT OLD."mean" OR NEW."sd" IS NOT OLD."sd" OR NEW."n" IS NOT OLD."n"
  OR NEW."fromDate" IS NOT OLD."fromDate" OR NEW."approvedBy" IS NOT OLD."approvedBy"
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'QC_CHART_LIMITS_IMMUTABLE') END;
END;
